name: Autauga
gaps: 7530 source rows collapsed to 7047 parcel ids (duplicate ids, stacked units, or rings that failed the WGS84 check). The acreage query covered the county.
No sale price on the public parcel layer. lastSale.price stays null.
Autauga_Parcels on the Prattville AGOL org is the owner and tax source. The county Ering map is geometry-only and was not used.
No Autauga county zoning REST. Prattville zoning is joined by centroid where it overlaps.

Prattville zoning is ZONING_JULY_2017 (internal layer name Zoning_2022). Vintage is unclear: sampled DATE_ZONED values are often May 1, 1987, with some later ordinances. Joined only where the polygon overlaps Autauga or Elmore parcels. Partial until a current official zoning service is confirmed.
Prattville Future_Land_Use_Layer has 13 coarse polygons and was not joined as site-level FLU.
